title: How a Camera Becomes a Mouse
subtitle: Smart Interactive Whiteboard — four-step mini-lesson
body: A fixed camera observes the projected board.
A bright pointer supplies a reliable image position.
Remote buttons provide discrete left and right clicks.

title: 1. Find the Pointer
subtitle: Color conversion, thresholding, and connected components
body: Convert BGR pixels to HSV with NumPy.
Threshold color, remove speckles, then fill small holes.
Use the largest blob centroid as the measured position.

title: 2. Map Camera to Board
subtitle: Four corners determine a 3 × 3 homography
body: Click board corners: TL, TR, BR, BL.
Normalized DLT solves H with singular-value decomposition.
Perspective division maps (u, v) into board pixels (X, Y).

title: 3. Interact and Annotate
subtitle: Stable motion plus explicit click events
body: Adaptive smoothing rejects jitter and isolated jumps.
Next generates a left click; Previous generates a right click.
